title: Dell security advisory (AV26-934)
description: As of September 17, 2026, Dell is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
Dell OpenManage Server Administrator (OMSA)
	Multiple versions and models

Dell Update Package (DUP) Framework
	Prior to 26.07.03

Dell Wyse Management Suite
	Prior to 2605.0.3.683
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
